build_hint: A folder of PNGs. It is read and shown below before anything is written. Add spec.json to set hotspots, animation frames and delays.
drift: Layers disagree — apply a theme to bring your compositor, GTK and Qt back in sync.
engine_missing: The cursor engine did not run. Check that python3 is installed.
import_hint: A Windows cursor pack folder. It is read and shown below before anything is written. An Install.inf is used when present.
install_hint: A folder holding a cursors/ directory. Windows packs go in the Import tab.
map_source_files: Files in this folder — drag one onto a role, or pick a role then a file
needs_arrow: No arrow cursor was found — assign one below, then convert again.
none_removable: Nothing installed yet — system themes cannot be removed here.
not_a_folder: Build needs a folder of PNGs, not a file.
picker_missing: zenity is not installed — type the path instead, or install zenity.
role_help: Help select — arrow with a question mark
role_size_ew: Resize left/right ↔ — left or right edge
role_size_ns: Resize up/down ↕ — top or bottom edge
role_wait: Busy — hourglass or spinner, the app is not responding
role_working: Working in background — arrow with a spinner
